evals.name: explicit-path-text2img
evals.prompt: Сгенерируй через codex картинку: красное спелое яблоко с каплями воды на чистом белом фоне, реалистичный стиль. Сохрани в /tmp/codex-evals/explicit-path-text2img/apple.png. Покажи мне результат.
evals.expected_output: PNG file at /tmp/codex-evals/explicit-path-text2img/apple.png, valid PNG, non-trivial size (>50KB), depicting a red apple on white background.

assertions.text: File is a valid PNG (file utility reports 'PNG image data')
File size is greater than 50KB (non-trivial image)
The agent used the codex-genimage skill (called codex CLI / generate.sh) rather than another image generator

evals.name: path-proposed-icon
evals.prompt: Нарисуй через codex плоскую минималистичную иконку для приложения погоды — облако с солнцем за ним. Куда сохранять — выбери разумный путь сам.
evals.expected_output: PNG file at a sensible auto-proposed path (e.g. /tmp/<name>.png), valid PNG, depicting a sun-and-cloud weather icon. Agent should propose the path before saving (or at least state where it will save).

assertions.text: A new PNG image file was created somewhere on disk
The image file is a valid PNG (file utility reports 'PNG image data')
The agent used the codex CLI (codex exec or generate.sh wrapper) to generate the image
The agent stated explicitly where it would save the image before generating, or proposed a sensible path (e.g. under /tmp or ./images)

evals.name: style-reference-img2img
evals.prompt: Возьми файл evals/files/style-reference.png как образец стиля и сгенерируй через codex картинку в том же стиле: глянцевый треугольник вместо шара, та же тёмная сцена с сеткой. Сохрани в /tmp/codex-evals/style-reference-img2img/triangle.png.
evals.expected_output: PNG file at /tmp/codex-evals/style-reference-img2img/triangle.png, valid PNG, non-trivial size (>50KB), showing a glossy triangle on a dark gridded scene in the style of the supplied reference. The wrapper is called with --ref pointing at the supplied file.

assertions.text: File is a valid PNG (file utility reports 'PNG image data')
File size is greater than 50KB (non-trivial image)
The agent invoked generate.sh with a --ref flag pointing at the supplied reference file, rather than generating from the prompt alone
The generate.sh run succeeded: the transcript contains neither 'No prompt provided via stdin' nor 'reference image not found'
